title: Shared stack: one distribution and bucket, host-to-tenant routing, wildcard subdomain
description:
Acceptance:
Scenario: Two hosts show two tenants
  Given tenants on a.example and b.example subdomains
  When each host is requested
  Then each returns only its own site and an unknown host returns a 404

First tenant: Threat Intelligence moves in as tenant #1, only after (a) the brand-neutral acceptance test passes on the standard layout and (b) real tenant authorisation (epic PPY-e0c34a) is enforced, because no outside data may share a tier until isolation holds. A separate staging tenant (PPY-1192d3) stays for release checks.
Scenario: TI is served from the shared stack
  Given TI passes the acceptance test and tenant authorisation is enforced
  When TI is moved to the shared stack
  Then it is served by host routing and its old origin is kept for rollback
